name: Tokunaga Yuuto
source:
An ordinary office worker.

Back during his student days, he became close friends with Koudai and the others in his class. He wasn’t the type to stand out much among the girls. He began dating Satsuki after entering university.

There was a time when things seemed to be "looking good" with Ria, wasn't there...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc094/index.html]official website[/url]]
